text:
maria.s: Heads up — I'm seeing permission drift in `service-account-team`. After yesterday's RBAC refactor some users still have `infra-admin-lite` even though SCIM deprovision should've removed it.

jonathan: Which users? any evidence it's from SCIM vs manual grant?

maria.s: Quick audit query below; shows deprovision event but role remains.

```
SELECT user_id, groups, roles FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id IN ('u-245','u-612') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5;
-- results: u-245 groups: [engineering,service-account-team] roles: [infra-admin-lite]
```

maria.s: Also saw KMS access entries around the same time: `kms:Encrypt` from a service token tied to u-245 at 2024-11-02T03:12Z

tamika: I think this lines up with my mapping change in PR #1123 — I renamed group 'infra-admins' -> 'infra-admin-lite' and updated the RBAC role, but forgot to update the SCIM mapping in idp-config.

leo: That would explain it. SCIM mapping still maps AD group `infra-admins` -> role `infra-admin-lite`? mismatch on group name could leave orphaned role links.

scim-sync-bot: SCIM sync run completed at 2024-11-02T03:00Z. 12 users added, 4 deprovisioned, 2 sync-errors: mapping_not_found

security-oncall: Stop all non-critical deploys until we confirm no elevation. @deploy-bot please pause canary.

deploy-bot: Pausing canary and staging deploys until cleared :white_check_mark:

jonathan: Can we run the force-deprovision script to scrub orphaned roles and then re-run SCIM? We should capture output.

maria.s: Plan:
- revoke sessions/tokens for affected users (leo)
- run `tools/scim/force_deprov.sh --dry-run` then actual run (leo)
- patch idp-config mapping and redeploy SCIM config (tamika)
- rotate the service KMS key tied to the affected token (security-oncall)
- add an alert for mapping_not_found to catch future drift (jonathan)
- postmortem + ACL audit for last 7 days (maria.s)

leo: I'll start with dry-run in 10m and paste logs here. If dry-run shows >0 orphaned role attachments I'll execute actual.

tamika: pushed updated idp-config to branch fix/scim-map-1123, linking to PR. After patch we should run a full sync and validate members count.

maria.s: Thanks. Also creating an audit watch for any KMS grants created in last 30d tied to users that were deprovisioned.

jonathan: +1. If anyone finds manual grants in the tenant console, flag them — we may need an emergency ACL rollback.

scim-sync-bot: dry-run output (summary): 2 orphaned_role_attachments detected for u-245, u-612. No forced removals in dry-run.

leo: executing now. Will paste output when done.
